title: test(ui): three ui/ script tests spell their temp bases so the whole-tree scratch-dir sweep reads them (PM dispatch-gates red on main)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoCtY9d51b1p6bnTRQmr2tqL)_

Fixes #25851
Part of #25677 (cutover aftercare, bill item 50).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Why main is red

`Lint · PM dispatch-gates` runs `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`. On `push` and `schedule` that runs both tiers of the battery; on `pull_request` and the merge queue it runs the fast tier only. That is why every PR run of the cutover sitting was green while every push and schedule run since `fd40831416` (#25825) has been red.

Job log of check-run 121332957566 (push run 40247793996, `90a34e2039`), the only two red lines:

```
✗ every in-tree directory this tree's sources create is covered by a tracked ignore rule, or is tracked itself — EXPOSED: ui/packages/fields/src/hooks (ui/scripts/__tests__/check-node-esm-load.test.ts:141), ui/packages/fields/sub (ui/scripts/__tests__/check-node-esm-load.test.ts:463)
✗ no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read — UNRESOLVED: ui/scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts:131 (a bare relative literal, resolved against a cwd this scan cannot see: ''), ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:142 (a bare relative literal, resolved against a cwd this scan cannot see: ''), ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:198 (a bare relative literal, resolved against a cwd this scan cannot see: '')
✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 2 of 2182 case(s) failed.
```

Both are slow-tier live-tree cases of the scratch-directory sweep (`exposedScratchDirs` in `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`). Since the import it reads `ui/` sources too, and it misreads two spellings in three `ui/` script tests:

1. `check-node-esm-load.test.ts` binds `dir` to a temp directory in most tests (`const dir = tmpdir()`, a local helper over `os.tmpdir()`), and to `path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'packages/fields')` and `'packages/auth'` in two tests that only read package files. The sweep does not track scope and lets an in-tree reading win (its stated bias), so every `mkdirSync(path.join(dir, …))` in the file read as a directory created under `ui/packages/fields`.
2. `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` and `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` declare `let scratch = ''` and assign the real base (`mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), …))`) in `beforeAll`. The empty literal reads as a cwd-relative `mkdtempSync` base, and the two readings disagree, so the site stays unresolved.

## What this changes

The three test sources only. No gate, fixture, workflow or ignore rule changes, and no test changes behaviour.

- `check-node-esm-load.test.ts`: the two package-reading tests name their binding `pkgDir`.
- `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts`, `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`: `let scratch: string;`, so the `beforeAll` assignment is the only reading.

The nine `mkdirSync(path.join(dir, …))` sites in `check-node-esm-load.test.ts` now read as unresolved `mkdirSync` (one `dir` comes from `withTaskLog(…)`, an arrow function the resolver does not follow), the same class line 706 of that file already had. The live case counts only unresolved `mkdtempSync` sites, so they do not red it, and none of them reads as in-tree any more.

## Evidence

All on this branch's base, main `e167956e`, with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs` (the step's second command, both tiers):

| | before (main `e167956e`) | after (this branch, `a5958c7b`) |
|---|---|---|
| battery | `✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 2 of 2182 case(s) failed.` (exit 1, the same two lines as CI) | `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass.` (exit 0) |
| live sweep | 2 exposed, 3 unresolved `mkdtempSync` | 0 exposed, 0 unresolved `mkdtempSync` (2388 sites across 18098 tracked sources, 82 in-tree roots) |

- `node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` with the push environment: exit 0.
- `npx vitest run` on the three files (from `ui/`): 3 files, 86 tests pass.
- `npx tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit` (from `ui/`): 21 errors before and after, all pre-existing unbuilt `@objectstack/spec` subpath errors, none in these files.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` for the three paths derives 18; all 18 ran, exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: `✓ 18 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- Since this branch's base, main gained #25852 and #25856. Neither touches these files or adds a `mkdtempSync`/`mkdirSync` call.

This PR's own CI runs the fast tier only, so it cannot show the fixed cases. The proof is the first green push run of `Lint & Type Check` on main after this lands; its run id goes on #25851.

Tier S: three `ui/scripts/__tests__/` files, no governed surface. `skip-changeset`: publishes nothing. The known Test UI 8/16 and 9/16 reds belong to the next 4b PR and are not touched.
